# Blend research v3: result tables (generated by backtest/v3/report.R)

Tune window 2018–2022 only: 1365 non-tie games, scored against the no-vig close (C0). Every table below is rendered from the CSVs in this directory. BH q-values run across all 39 moneyline candidates (v2 and v3). Bootstrap: week blocks, B = 10,000.

## 1. Every family, uncalibrated (headline)

Slope and intercept come from the logistic recalibration fit y ~ a + b·logit(p) (perfect calibration: a = 0, b = 1). DM p is the one-sided Diebold–Mariano (HLN) test that the candidate's Brier is lower than the close's. `fit (s)` sums the weekly fit times over the whole walk (v2 families: their level-0 walk 2014–2022 in this run; the base models C1, C2, E1 are not timed separately). The table is sorted by skill.

## 3. Probability quality: calibration of every candidate

ECE uses 10 equal-count bins. Calibration-in-the-large is the intercept of y ~ 1 with offset logit(p) (0 = right on average). All CIs are Wald 95%. The gap column is the mean |logit(p) − logit(close)|: how far the candidate moves from the market.

## 4. Reliability: mean predicted / observed home-win rate in 10 equal-count bins

Bins are deciles of each candidate's own predictions (n = 136–137 games per bin). `reliability_tune.csv` has every candidate, including v2's calibration variants, with each bin's n and a Wilson 95% CI on the observed rate.
